verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              तस्मिंस्तु निहते शूरे शाल्वे समिति शोभने। तवाभज्यद्बलं वेगाद्वातेनेव महाद्रुमः॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said After the heroic Shalya, that flower of the court, had been killed your ariny were dispersed like a huge tree broken by the force of the storm.

verses.sanskrit: तत् प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा कृतवर्मा महारथः। दधार समरे शूरः शत्रुसैन्यं महाबलः॥२॥
verses.english: Seeing the army routed, the great carwarrior, Kritavarına, opposed the hostile force in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: सन्निवृत्तास्तु ते शूरा दृष्ट्वा सात्वतमाहवे। शैलोपमं स्थिरं राजन् कीर्यमाणं शरैर्युधि॥३॥
verses.english: Seeing the Satwata hero, O king, standing in battle like a hill though struck with arrows (by the foe), the Kuru heroes, who had fled away, rallied and came back.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरूणां पाण्डवैः सह। निवृत्तानां महाराज मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥४॥
verses.english: Then, O king, an encounter which took place between the Pandavas and the Kurus who were determined upon meeting with death.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राश्चर्यमभूद्युद्धं सात्वतस्य परैः सह। यदेको वारयामास पाण्डुसेनां दुरासदाम्॥५॥
verses.english: Wonderful was that fierce encounter which took place between the Satwata hero and his foes, since alone hc opposed the invincible ariny of the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामन्योन्यसुहृदां कृते कर्मणि दुष्करे। सिंहनादः प्रहृष्टानां दिविस्पृक् सुमहानभूत्॥६॥
verses.english: Seeing this most difficult feat friends, filled with delight, set up leonine shouts that sceined to reach the very heavens.

verses.sanskrit: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ताः पञ्चालान् भरतर्षभ। शिनेर्नप्ता महाबाहुरन्वपद्यत सात्यकिः॥७॥
verses.english: At those sounds and Panchalas, O foremost of Bharata's race, were filled with fear. Then Satyaki, the grandson of Shini, came there.

verses.sanskrit: स समासाद्य राजानं क्षेमधूर्तिं महाबलम्। सप्तभिर्निशितैर्बाणैरनयद्यमसादनम्॥८॥
तमायान्तं महाबाहुं प्रवपन्तं शिताञ्शरान्। जवेनाभ्यपतद्धीमान्हार्दिक्यः शिनिपुङ्गवम्॥९॥
verses.english: Then the intelligent son of Hridika, rushed quickly against the best of Shinis, that mightyarmed warrior, as the latter came discharging his whetted shafts.

verses.sanskrit: सात्वतौ च महावीर्यौ धन्विनौ रथिनां वरौ। अन्योन्यमभिधावेतां शस्त्रप्रवरधारिणौ॥१०॥
verses.english: Those two bowmen, those two foremost of car-warriors roared like lions and met each other, both being armed with best of weapons.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवाः सहपञ्चाला योधाश्चान्ये नृपोत्तमाः। प्रेक्षकाः समपद्यन्त तयोर्घोरे समागमे॥११॥
verses.english: The Pandavas, the Panchalas and the other warriors, witnessed that terrible encounter between the two heroes.

verses.sanskrit: नाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैश्च वृष्ण्यन्धकमहारथौ। अभिजघ्नतुरन्योन्यं प्रहृष्टाविव कुञ्जरौ॥१२॥
verses.english: Those two Vrishni and Andhaka heroes, like two elephants filled with delight, struck each other with long arrows and arrows with calf-toothed heads.

verses.sanskrit: चरन्तौ विविधान्मार्गान् हार्दिक्यशिनिपुङ्गवौ। मुहुरन्तर्दधाते तौ बाणवृष्ट्या परस्परम्॥१३॥
verses.english: Moving about in various ways the son of Hridika and that foremost of Shini's race soon covered each other with showers of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: चापवेगबलोद्धृतान्मार्गणान् वृष्णिसिंहयोः। आकाशे समपश्याम पतङ्गानिव शीघ्रगान्॥१४॥
verses.english: The arrows discharged forcibly from the bows of the two Vrishni heroes were seen by us in the sky to resemble fights of quickcoursing insects.

verses.sanskrit: तमेकं सत्यकर्माणमासाद्य हृदिकात्मजः। अविध्यन्निशितैर्बाणैश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्॥१५॥
verses.english: Approaching the powerful Satyaki of true prowess, the son of Hridika struck the four horses of the former with four keen arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन हृद्येनं समताडयत्। स युद्धे युयुधानेन हताश्वो हतसारथिः॥१५॥
verses.english: Approaching the powerful Satyaki of true prowess, the son of Hridika struck the four horses of the former with four keen arrows.

verses.sanskrit: स दीर्घबाहुः सङ्क्रुद्धस्तोत्रादित इव द्विपः। अष्टभिः कृतवर्माणमविद्ध्यत्परमेषुभिः॥१६॥
verses.english: Enraged at this like an elephant struck with a lance, the long-armed Satyaki struck Kritavarman with eight best arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैः कृतवर्मा शिलाशितैः। सात्यकिं त्रिभिराहत्य धनुरेकेन चिच्छिदे॥१७॥
निकृत्तं तद्धनुः श्रेष्ठमपास्य शिनिपुङ्गवः। अन्यदादत्त वेगेन शैनेयः सशरं धनुः॥१८॥
verses.english: Casting off his broken bow, that Shini hero quickly took up another with an arrow set on it.

verses.sanskrit: तदादाय धनुः श्रेष्ठं वरिष्ठः सर्वधन्विनाम्। आरोग्य च धनुः शीघ्रं महावीर्यो महाबलः॥१९॥
verses.english: Having taken up that best of bows and stringed it, that foremost of all bowmen, that warrior of great energy, intelligence and strength, unable to bear the cutting of his bow by Kritavarman, quickly and furiously rushed against the latter.

verses.sanskrit: अमृष्यमाणो धनुषश्छेदनं कृतवर्मणा। कुपितोऽतिरथः शीघ्रं कृतवर्माणमभ्ययात्॥२०॥
ततः सुनिशितैर्बाणैर्दशभिः शिनिपुङ्गवः। जघान सूतं चाश्वांश्च ध्वजं च कृतवर्मणः॥२१॥
verses.english: With ten keen arrows that Shini chief then struck the driver, the horses and the standard of Kritavarman.

verses.sanskrit: ततो राजन्महेष्वासः कृतवर्मा महारथः। हताश्वसूतं सम्प्रेक्ष्य रथं हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥२२॥
verses.english: At this, O king, the great bowinan and carwarrior Kritavarman, beholding his golddecked car made driverless and horseless, was filled with rage. Taking up a pointed lance, he discharged it with all might at that best of Shini's race, desirous of killing him.

verses.sanskrit: रोषेण महताऽऽविष्टः शूलमुद्यम्य मारिष। चिक्षेप भुजवेगेन जिघांसुः शिनिपुङ्गवम्॥२३॥
तच्छूलं सात्वतो ह्याजौ निर्भिद्य निशितैः शरैः। चूर्णितं पातयामास मोहयन्निव माधवम्॥२४॥
verses.english: Striking that lance with many keen arrows, Satyaki sundered it off into pieces and caused it to fall down. Stupefying Kritavarinan of Madhu's race with another broad-headed arrow he then struck Kritavarman on the chest.

verses.sanskrit: कृतवर्मा कृतस्तेन धरणीमन्वपद्यत। तस्मिन्सात्यकिना वीरे द्वैरथे विरथीकृते॥२६॥
verses.english: The heroic Kritavarman, having been deprived of his car by Satyaki in that single combat, all the (Kaurava) soldiers were possessed by a great fear.

verses.sanskrit: समपद्यत सर्वेषां सैन्यानां सुमहद्भयम्। पुत्रस्य तव चात्यर्थं विषादः समजायत॥२७॥
verses.english: A mighty fear overtook your sons, when Kritavarman was thus made steedless and driverless and carless.

verses.sanskrit: हतसूते हताश्वे तु विरथे कृतवर्मणि। हताश्वं च समालक्ष्य हतसूतमरिन्दम॥२८॥
अभ्यधावत्कृपो राजञ्जिघांसुः शिनिपुङ्गवम्। तमारोप्य रथोपस्थे मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्॥२९॥
अपोवाह महाबाहुं तूर्णमायोधनादपि। शैनेयेऽधिष्ठिते राजन्विरथे कृतवर्मणि॥३०॥
verses.english: Taking Kritavarman upon his car before all the bowmen, the mighty-armed Kripa took him away from the battlefield.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनबलं सर्वं पुनरासीत्पराङ्मुखम्। तत्परे नान्वबुध्यन्त सैन्येन रजसा वृताः॥३१॥
तावकाः प्रद्रुता राजन्दुर्योधनमृते नृपम्। दुर्योधनस्तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य भग्नं स्वबलमन्तिकात्॥३२॥
verses.english: The enemy, however, did not see it for the Kuru army was then covered with a cloud of dust. All your warriors fled, O king, except king Duryodhana.

verses.sanskrit: जवेनाभ्यपत्तूर्णं सर्वांश्चैको न्यवारयत्। पाण्डूंश्च सर्वान्सङ्क्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नं च पार्षतम्॥३३॥
verses.english: Beholding his own army thus routed he quickly rushed and assailed the victorious enemy, alone opposing them all.

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डिनं द्रौपदेयान्पञ्चालानां च ये गणाः। केकयान्सोमकांश्चैव सृञ्जयांश्चैव मारिष॥३४॥
verses.english: Filled with rage, that invincible warrior assailed with keen arrows all the Pandus and Dhrishtadyumna the son of Prishata and Shikhandin and the son of Draupadi and the large numbers of the Panchalas and the Kaikeyas and the Somakas.

verses.sanskrit: असम्भ्रमं दुराधर्षः शितैर्बाणैरवाकिरत्। अतिष्ठदाहवे यत्तः पुत्रस्तव महाबलः॥३५॥
यथा यज्ञे महानग्निर्मन्त्रपूतः प्रकाशवान्। तथा दुर्योधनो राजा सङ्ग्रामे सर्वतोऽभवत्॥३६॥
verses.english: With strong determination your powerful son stood in battle. even as blazing and mighty fire on the sacrificial platform purified with mantras, king Duryodhana moved in the field, in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: तं परे नाभ्यवर्तन्त मर्त्या मृत्युमिवाहवे। अथान्यं रथमास्थाय हार्दिक्यः समपद्यत॥३७॥
